description.value:
The Shadow Guard archetype is a Sentinel whose personal Ideal is vigilance without recognition, a quiet watcher who would rather prevent a disaster unseen than be thanked for stopping one in the open. Shadow Guards specialize in tailing threats, striking from concealment, and vanishing again before the dust settles.

They develop an affinity for Force techniques that mask their presence and movement, punishing strikes delivered from hiding, and the discipline to hold back — sometimes for a very long time — until the exact right moment to intervene.
